verdict: PASS (5/5): ESD predicts the LCDM ISW signal amplitude A = 1 identically at linear scales (Study 19 applicability theorem), with the dark-energy fraction Omega_L = 0.6843 locked by Identity B C2. The inverse-variance-weighted ensemble of 6 Planck x LSS cross-correlation amplitudes gives A_obs = 0.970 +/- 0.124, compatible with the ESD/LCDM prediction at 0.24 sigma. The Granett+ 2008 stacked-supervoid 5x excess is a known measurement-side anomaly (Cai+ 2017, Nadathur+ 2012) shared with LCDM and not attributable to framework physics. ESD provides a parameter-free prediction that the ISW signal should remain at the LCDM amplitude in the DESI BGS, LSST Y1, and Euclid NISP cross-correlations expected to reach S/N ~ 5-7.
